evidence.source: CUHK Humanum 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.text: Oracle-bone and bronze forms depict a loaded bag tied at both ends. The character is borrowed for east already in these scripts. The sun-inside-tree analysis is rejected; graphic relatives include 束 and 橐.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 東
